notes: First year of centralized official statistics collection by JCG.
Kim Jong Un initiates 'fisheries speed battle' campaign.
Severe autumn/winter storms; boats found with skeletal remains.
Autumn surge in Sea of Japan / Yamato Bank.
Surge following UNSCR 2371 seafood export ban and sale of fishing rights to Chinese trawlers.
All-time record peak: 225 boats. Extreme fuel shortages and desperate deep-sea ventures.
Second-highest year on record; clashes with JCG patrol ships at Yamato Bank.
Sharp drop in H2 2020 due to draconian DPRK COVID-19 border closure and maritime quarantine shoot-to-kill orders.
Total lockdown: DPRK prohibits small craft operations near borders.
Partial resumption of inshore fishing activities.
Strict naval patrols continue; large steel vessels preferred over small wooden craft.
Lowest level in over a decade; recorded in MOFA Diplomatic Bluebook 2025.
